name: Steel-cored heel
summary: A heel with a steel rod inside and a steel shank in the arch. The metal lets a thin heel carry the weight of the body.
how: Cast a steel rod in the heel, 3 to 5 mm in diameter.
Rivet a steel shank in the arch of the sole.
Cover the heel and set a rubber top piece at the tip.

origin.note: Shoemakers fit a steel rod in a thin heel.

adoptions.via: Vivier and the couture houses fit thin steel-cored heels to the court shoe.
